title: An Egg Walks on Its Own Legs
logline: A young Ethiopian girl learns patience from her mother during long Saturday walks to market, carrying a lesson that warms her family generations later.

audience.who: Young Ethiopians at home and in the diaspora, 18-35, watching on a phone
audience.feel: Warmth and pride for the long walks our grandparents made, and the urge to call them

style.block: Stylized low-poly 3D animation still: faceted surfaces with visible flat polygons, toy-like rounded characters with simple dark oval eyes and small calm mouths, soft matte materials, cinematic warm key light against cool deep-blue shadows, soft circular bokeh lights in the background, shallow depth of field, gentle film grain
style.motion: low-poly 3D animation, smooth and slow, faceted shapes stay stable, no morphing

characters.name: Little Grandmother (Child)
characters.look: 8 years old, petite build, dark brown expressive eyes, hair styled in neat traditional shurba cornrows, wearing a simple white cotton habesha kemis dress with subtle woven tibeb trim along the hem.

reference.prompt: 8-year-old Ethiopian girl in traditional white dress with braided cornrows, standing softly against mist

characters.name: Great-Grandmother
characters.look: 30 years old, tall and graceful, gentle smiling expression, hair wrapped in a crisp white scarf, wearing a traditional white habesha kemis with a white netela shawl around her shoulders.

reference.prompt: 30-year-old Ethiopian woman in traditional white cotton kemis and netela shawl, carrying a woven basket

characters.name: Grandmother (Present Day)
characters.look: 75 years old, same rounded face shape and warm eyes as young_girl, silvery-white hair visible beneath a soft white netela, wearing a cozy embroidered dress.

reference.prompt: 75-year-old Ethiopian grandmother smiling joyfully while roasting coffee over a small stove

locations.name: Wollo Rural Mountain Path
locations.look: Dawn breaking over misty Wollo hills, golden cool light, tall green eucalyptus trees lining a winding dirt trail, a small log bridge over a flowing creek.

reference.prompt: Misty Ethiopian countryside path at dawn with tall eucalyptus trees and green hills, wide landscape view

locations.name: Dessie Open Market
locations.look: Vibrant morning sunshine, rustic wooden stalls, woven baskets filled with red spices and green coffee beans, light rising smoke from roasted beans.

reference.prompt: Traditional Ethiopian open market in Dessie with coffee stalls and woven baskets, warm morning sunlight

locations.name: Family Living Room
locations.look: Cozy contemporary room bathed in warm afternoon sun, traditional wooden coffee tray (rekebot), black clay jebena pot, steam rising into soft light.

reference.prompt: Warm sunlit room with traditional Ethiopian coffee ceremony setup on a wooden rekebot tray

shots.beat: Establish the long, early journey of the past.
shots.reason: Establishes setting, atmospheric mood, and echoes the physical distance walked.

lines.speaker: narrator_grandma
lines.en: The Wollo air was always fresh at dawn.

keyframe.prompt: Wide view of dawn over Wollo hills, misty eucalyptus path with two figures walking away into distant blue fog, soft golden sunrise light.

motion.prompt: The camera slowly pans right following the two figures walking down the misty trail as morning light warms the horizon.
motion.subject: ambient

shots.music_cue: Gentle acoustic krar plucking enters softly with warm ambient pads.

shots.beat: Show the heavy cargo carried with care.
shots.reason: Highlights the effort and traditional items (butter in leaves, eggs in basket).

lines.speaker: narrator_grandma
lines.en: Carrying butter and eggs all the way to Dessie.

keyframe.prompt: Little girl holding small black clay pots wrapped tightly in shiny broad green banana leaves, mother carrying a woven grass basket nearby.

motion.prompt: The camera moves slowly beside them as they step together along the dirt path, leaves brushing their clothes.
motion.subject: character

shots.music_cue: Rhythmic, quiet shaker joins the soft string melody.

shots.beat: Highlight childhood fear overcome by guidance.
shots.reason: Creates emotional vulnerability and trust between mother and child.

lines.speaker: narrator_grandma
lines.en: Crossing the stream always frightened her.

keyframe.prompt: Little girl standing hesitatingly at the edge of a rushing stream wooden plank, mother reaching her hand back with a reassuring warm smile.

motion.prompt: The mother reaches out her hand and the girl steps across the stream to her side. Static camera.
motion.subject: character

end_keyframe.prompt: Same place, same camera and light: the girl now stands on the far bank of the stream holding her mother's hand, both smiling.

shots.music_cue: Music pauses softly, leaving gentle water sounds.

shots.beat: Arrival at the reward—the sensory joy of the market.
shots.reason: Connects grandmother's childhood love of coffee to the present tradition.

lines.speaker: narrator_grandma
lines.en: The sweet aroma of coffee was her greatest joy.

keyframe.prompt: Young girl smiling brightly in warm sunlit market, holding a dark roasted coffee bean up to her nose as wisps of fragrant smoke float by.

motion.prompt: The girl gently brings the roasted bean close, closes her eyes happily, while smoke drifts slowly upward.
motion.subject: character

mask.target: the girl's face, hands and the coffee bean she holds

shots.beat: Autonomy and responsibility granted to the girl.
shots.reason: Shows her growing role within the family ritual.

lines.speaker: narrator_grandma
lines.en: Bargaining for coffee was her special task.

keyframe.prompt: Child's small hand carefully picking green raw coffee beans out of a wide woven straw tray.

motion.prompt: Slow camera zoom-in onto the child's delicate hand picking coffee beans.

shots.beat: The key lesson delivered on the long trek back.
shots.reason: Delivers the core proverb and central moral of the story.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.en: Little by little, an egg will walk on its own legs.

keyframe.prompt: Late afternoon sun lighting yellow grass, tired little girl walking slowly looking up at mother, mother looking down lovingly while speaking.

motion.prompt: They walk slowly together in profile as camera pans alongside them through golden light.
motion.subject: character

shots.music_cue: Theme plays softly, resting on a sustained warm chord.

shots.beat: Pause to let the wisdom settle into memory.
shots.reason: Focuses on the physical rhythm of patient walking.

keyframe.prompt: Close-up of four feet walking side by side on dusty ground: small bare child feet and mother's traditional leather sandals.

motion.prompt: Slow pan-right tracking the feet walking step by step on dusty earth.

shots.music_cue: Solo instrumental breath, silent beats allowing proverb to echo.

shots.beat: Seamless shift from past memory to present reality.
shots.reason: Brings the tradition into modern family life.

lines.speaker: narrator_grandma
lines.en: Today, she roasts coffee for us on Sundays.

keyframe.prompt: Elderly grandmother sitting indoors in warm sunlight, roasting coffee beans over charcoal pan, thin swirl of aromatic white smoke surrounding her hands.

motion.prompt: The camera gently moves in as she rotates the pan slowly, smoke drifting across the sunlight.
motion.subject: character

mask.target: the grandmother's hands, the roasting pan and the smoke above it

shots.music_cue: Main melody transforms into a warmer modern acoustic arrangement.

shots.reason: Emphasizes the grandmother's joy in serving her loved ones.

lines.speaker: narrator_grandma
lines.en: When one of us impatiens, she laughs.

keyframe.prompt: Close view of grandmother's wrinkled, gentle hands pouring rich black coffee from a dark clay jebena into tiny porcelain cups on a tray.

motion.prompt: Dark coffee pours smoothly into the small cup as steam rises gently towards the lens.
motion.subject: ambient

mask.target: the stream of coffee pouring from the clay pot and the steam above the cups

shots.music_cue: Full chord progression builds with soft percussion.

shots.beat: The ancestral proverb reborn as family laughter.
shots.reason: Climax of emotional warmth, humor, and intergenerational bond.

lines.speaker: old_grandma
lines.en: Little by little, an egg will walk on its own legs!

keyframe.prompt: Elderly grandmother laughing happily, twinkling eyes, shaking her head playfully while gesturing with her hand.

motion.prompt: Grandmother tilts her head back in gentle laughter, her warm smile filling the frame.
motion.subject: character

shots.music_cue: Music reaches its most joyful, heart-filling phrase.

shots.beat: Closing the circle back to the landscape of origin.

lines.speaker: narrator_grandma
lines.en: Our grandparents' long walks live on within us.
